name: El Shaddai Coin & Epic
summary:
El Shaddai Coin & Epic is a free-to-play coin-pusher arcade game based on the El Shaddai universe, originally released for Android devices in Japan.

Featuring Enoch and Lucifel from El Shaddai: Ascension of the Metatron, the game presents a lighthearted story in which Enoch must earn coins to help pay Lucifel's mobile phone bills.
